The accessible account attributes the second reported incident to a different tool. The date records publication of that account; the underlying incident date is unspecified, so this is context rather than a separately dated outage finding.

Amazon explicitly denies a second AWS event and attributes the December interruption to access-control error. This dates the denial, not an independently established finding about the disputed incidents.

Amazon's clarification says the meeting concerned retail infrastructure, so it cannot establish additional AWS outages. This item dates the clarification; the statement also disputes reports of new AI-specific approval requirements.
